collection.label: P75 (Papyrus Hanna 1)
collection.search_terms: p75 papyrus hanna mater verbi bodmer xiv xv luke john vatican
collection.description: The oldest copy of Luke and one of the oldest of John: the papyrus codex P75 (c. 175-225) in the Vatican Library, page by page.

authors.name: Papyrus P75 (scribe)
authors.bio: Unknown Egyptian scribe of the papyrus codex of Luke and John now called Papyrus Hanna 1 (Mater Verbi), a careful copyist whose text is close to Codex Vaticanus.
